task_specification.objective: Close the three required combat_readability gaps by isolating authoritative weapon-report ownership, rebuilding the affected shell and event HUD around responsive borderless layout, and making existing enemy-combat preparation and advancement deterministically inspectable without changing the preserved map, environment, viewmodel, or ordinary mission authority.

diagnosis.root_cause: Three independent integration seams block combat_readability. Player fire has competing report ownership: the retained FireAudio/AutoFireAudio path now builds a physically bounded transient, but generic shot feedback still creates spatial report audio for player shots, while cleanup and lifecycle proof remains incomplete. Product UI uses fixed-size/global-scale composition and parallel right-side text lanes, causing 200 percent clipping, an opaque loadout card, and overlapping event notices. Enemy roster behavior is substantially implemented, but the existing accelerated setup did not advance from stable 3/5/10 presence into inspectable perception, movement, aim, fire, reload, hurt, and death states; this is an evidence-enablement gap rather than proof that ordinary AI is defective.

stop_conditions: Stop and restore the bounded change if clean boot, authoritative gameplay entry, ordinary movement, mouse look, reload/F6 separation, or pause/resume regresses.
Do not edit, split, transform, or replace the retained AK-74M/Saiga-12 addon, recordings, hierarchy, profiles, hands, animations, recoil timings, or viewmodel framing.
Do not modify the intact Standoff map instance, its authored children, or the preserved environment and lighting tuple while addressing these surfaces.
If mixed-output capture is unavailable, retain the weapon-audio issue as unresolved evidence debt; stopped-player flags, configured duration, or receipts alone must not be treated as closure.

If the enemy prepare/advance fixtures already expose the required stable states and receipts, do not retune working AI merely to manufacture a code change; hand the unchanged behavior to Tester for ordinary-route and branch-local recapture.
Do not expand into deferred animation, bomb-finale, world-density, footstep, performance, or reticle work during this iteration.

strategy.rationale: Use materially different root-cause repairs: remove duplicate player-report ownership instead of tuning timeouts, replace fixed/global UI scaling with responsive container and scroll behavior instead of transform tweaks, and repair the existing prepare/advance observation seam instead of replaying or retuning unproven enemy behavior. This preserves accepted assets and concentrates recapture on the failed cells.
